paper_id: Liu et al. - 2012 - Ad-hoc Anonymity Privacy Preservation for Location-based Services in Mobile Networks
title: Ad-hoc Anonymity: Privacy Preservation for Location-based Services in Mobile Networks
motivation: LBS要求用户报告精确位置,隐私泄露严重,现有方案依赖中介或合作用户,限制应用
problem_framing: 如何在无中介条件下通过异步假名变更实现接近同步的隐私保护
key_insight: 虚拟用户(dummy)链式参与不同时间的假名变更,打破时间相关性使攻击者无法识别
method_signature: ad-hoc匿名:异步假名变更+dummy概率参与+假名链式混合
evaluation_criteria: 熵(匿名集有效大小)和服务会话时长
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 非合作用户限制可达隐私度,分布式方案难以同步大量用户
evidence_for_taste: lightweight and distributed, relying on no intermediary
A dummy does not care the quality of services
ambitious participation is transparent to attackers
an effective way to obscure attackers
this protects the dummy from being recognized
thinking_moves: 把匿名集分割问题转化为dummy链式链接问题
利用攻击者视角的不确定性证明dummy不可识别
用信息熵形式化隐私可度量性
从对抗性角度设计dummy生成时机
